userStories.title: Implement the BLOCK->re-plan loop with capped rounds and teardown seam
userStories.description: As the meta-loop, I need runPlanPhase wrapped in a deterministic BLOCK->re-plan loop (capped at MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS=2, mirroring the review loop's FIXES_PENDING->re-implement->MAX_ROUNDS control flow in loop.ts), so an audit-blocked PRD is re-planned with the auditor's findings instead of parking at idle every cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: A new exported function in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts (e.g. runPlanPhaseWithReplan) drives up to MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS rounds: round 1 runs runPlanPhase unchanged; on an audit-blocked result with rounds remaining it re-runs with plannerTaskPrompt built via buildReplanPlannerTaskPrompt(issue.id, priorFindings), pinned to the SAME issue (no re-selection); a round that returns audit-approved is the terminal and proceeds to the caller's branch path. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

The prior round's findings are captured from the in-memory audit-blocked result BEFORE the next round's clearStalePlanArtifactsFn deletes plan-verdict-report.json (plan-runner.ts:254 clear-at-start), and a test asserts the round-2 planner spawn prompt contains the non-empty round-1 findings text. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

After MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS consecutive audit-blocked rounds the function returns a terminal escalated-kind result (never audit-approved, never branch) and invokes an injected escalation-marker writer seam with the issue id and the LAST round's findings; a test asserts the writer is called with those fields and that no git/branch spawn occurs. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

An injected teardownPlanPanesFn seam is invoked on ALL terminal/boundary paths: after an audit-approved terminal, BEFORE each re-plan round's runPlanPhase call (so the pane-count mutex sees 'available'), and on the escalated terminal; a test asserts the seam fires on all three paths. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

Non-audit results (preflight-failed, no-plannable-issue, mutex-busy, planner-timeout, auditor-timeout, planner-failed, container-preflight-failed) are returned as-is and NEVER trigger a re-plan round. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts, test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts or new test/supervisor/plan/plan-replan.test.ts. Depends on US-001 (prompt builder + MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS) and US-002 (marker writer signature). Insertion point: the audit-blocked return documented as absent at plan-runner.ts lines 27 and 789. Control-flow precedent: the review loop in src/supervisor/loop.ts (decideNextAction / MAX_ROUNDS terminal), but per ADR-0012 the plan terminal is escalated, NEVER a MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT analog. Key mechanics: (a) findings are already in-memory on the audit-blocked PlanPhaseResult ({ issue, report }) - thread report.findings forward, do NOT re-read the file; (b) round 2 must pass plannerTaskPrompt as the opts override so runPlanPhase's buildPlannerTaskPrompt default is bypassed, and must pin selectIssueFn to the round-1 issue; (c) teardown BEFORE round 2 is functionally required or paneCountMutexFn returns 'busy' (auditor TUI pane never self-exits); (d) all seams injected (teardownPlanPanesFn, marker writer) so tests assert exact call sequences - keep runPlanPhase itself byte-for-byte compatible for existing tests. Biome limits: use factory/helper extraction (patterns.md), max 80 lines/function, complexity <=15.

userStories.title: Wire the re-plan loop, pane teardown, and durable escalation into the sidecar
userStories.description: As the sidecar plan phase, I need makeProductionPlanPhaseFn to drive the re-plan loop with real kill-pane teardown and the durable escalation marker, so a BLOCK no longer parks the meta-loop silently and a converged plan restores the 2-pane mutex.
acceptanceCriteria: makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) invokes the US-003 loop function instead of bare runPlanPhase, wiring: a teardownPlanPanesFn that resolves the pane id fresh from readWorkerPaneMarker and runs tmux kill-pane (NOT respawn-pane -k), best-effort and never-throwing (mirrors host.ts teardownWorkerPaneFn, CAM-188); and the plan-escalation marker writer targeting the .claude/ dir. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/]

On the non-convergence terminal, runPostPlanActions: writes the durable marker and emits the 'plan-escalated' event UNCONDITIONALLY (never gated on notifyFn or escalateFn presence/success - the pane push is a best-effort nudge only), fires notifyFn + escalateFn best-effort, and exits the phase to idle; a test asserts the marker exists even when notifyFn is absent. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/]

The planner/auditor panes are killed on all three production paths - APPROVE->branch-created, each re-plan boundary, and escalate - so no worker pane lingers and the pane-count mutex returns 'available' afterward; tests assert the kill-pane spawn on all three paths. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/]

A plan run that converges (audit-approved -> branch-created) removes any pre-existing plan-escalation marker, so a stale BLOCK escalation never outlives convergence. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/]
